# PNC PARK

# PNC PARK  
PNC Park, which opened in spring 2001, is an intimate, classic-style ballpark
that embraces the progressiveness of Pittsburgh while saluting the spirit of
early ballpark originals. Its prime location along the shore of the Allegheny
River takes advantage of scenic vistas of the downtown skyline and riverfront,
creating an exciting and dramatic urban sports venue.
